Title: [LSJ] Black Throne and House of Sorrow

Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body:
Can I use House of Sorrow to gain two pool from The Black Throne when
activating the latter for its poolgain effect? I seem to recall asking
something similar about Church of Vindicated Faith, which probably
works the same way, but Google Groups doesn't want to let me search
for that answer at the moment.

John Eno

The Black Throne
Master: unique location.
Tap during a referendum to gain 2 votes. Tap when a minion with a
contract leaves the ready region (only usable if an Assamite you
control had been chosen for that contract) to gain 1 pool.

House of Sorrow
Master: unique location.
Tap to untap any card you control that is not a minion. If you do so,
neither that card nor this location untap as normal on your next untap
phase.
